cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I planned this picnic, so I get first choice of cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Destination selection outranks transport. You can go second.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked it. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking outranks driving. But I commissioned the cake, so commissioning goes first. I'll take the end piece.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims first cake choice, A3 grants B second place and A5 promotes commissioning over baking, treating ranking authority as A own privilege.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 driving prompts A3 destination versus transport; B4 baking prompts A5 a new hierarchy with A commissioning above it.

heightening.evidence: B4 baker end-piece claim causes A5 to recognize baking yet invent a higher commissioning tier for A.

specificity.evidence: A1 picnic/cake and B4 baking establish the object of distribution; A5 commissioning is a new claim by the self-ranking character.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 promotes B baking only to place commissioning above it, earning the self-serving ranking joke from B4.
